pages.title: Charm Recipes
pages.text: An Extinguisher clears your burning and removes lava at the fairy's position each tick. Bind its typed charm while wearing the Ring of Binding.

pages.title: A Lighter's Glow
pages.text: When a Lighter reaches an empty spot below light level 10, it leaves a hidden light bright enough to guide you. The glow fades on its own, so it will not claim the space forever.
